meta.title: Add benchmark support for transpiler and VM tests
meta.body_summary: Add benchmark output recording for transpiler and VM Rosetta tests, generating duration and memory usage checklists, with a benchMainFlag to wrap generated main in a benchmark block.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR added benchmark infrastructure for transpiler/VM Rosetta tests; closed after ~9 months as stale/conflicted, superseded by main.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchmark output recording for transpiler and VM Rosetta tests: generates ROSETTA.md checklist with durations and memory usage; wraps generated main in benchmark block via benchMainFlag for transpiler examples.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Secondary files include generated ROSETTA checklists and benchmark .bench manifests; most are small additions/updates.
